title: Limit pull request reviews to one round sized to the diff

verdict.reason: A real harness rule backed by session cost data: about $11–20 per PR versus about $85 for looped review. The technique is one review round sized to the diff, skeptic checks only for findings that change a decision, claim or code, wording fixes applied without re-review, and a re-review of only the changed lines when an owner answer changes the diff. It is narrow but directly copyable, and the card matches the page.
